guide.description: A drum machine where every hit has a shape. Eight voices on 16 steps draw the rhythm as a picture that keeps moving on, in three styles, on the device and on a big screen.

controls.action: Start the preset beat; press again to stop.
Next style of picture: Score, Orbit, Weave. Change it any time, even mid-bar.
Cycle the step for the selected voice: on, accent, off.
Tempo, 40–240 BPM.
Swing: Off, Light, Medium, Heavy. Off-beat shapes move later with their sound.
Next colors.
Select a voice. Its shapes stand out.
Mute or unmute the selected voice. A muted voice leaves the picture.
Undo the last recorded hit or roll.
Tune the selected voice. Higher pitch, higher shape, and the whole picture leans with the tuning of all voices.
Reset its tune.
Record on or off. It starts off: K3 only plays.
Decay of the selected voice. A longer sound keeps its shape longer, and longer decays make every trace larger and longer-lived.
Reset its decay.
The selected voice's other shape.
Open Menu for Guide, audio, Reload or Exit.
Start or stop.
Play the selected voice. With Record on, a hit played while the pattern runs is written into the nearest step.
Roll: one more hit on every step until you let go.
Next pattern, A–D. While playing, it switches at the end of the bar.
Next style: Score, Orbit, Weave.
Cycle on, accent, off for the selected voice.
Select it; tap the selected voice again for its other shape. It lights when it plays.
Same as K3: tap to play the voice, hold to roll.
Record on or off, same as holding E3.
Undo the last recorded hit or roll. It shows once something is recorded.
Next style, same as holding K4.
Next colors, three sets.

sections.title: Shapes
sections.text: Disc: bass drum. Bar: snare. Ticks: closed hat. Ring: open hat. Squares: clap. Triangle: low tom. Slash: rim shot. Two rectangles: cowbell. An accent is larger and brighter.

sections.title: Styles
sections.text: Score: one bar, left to right, each voice on its own lane; over eight bars the lanes close into one line and open again. Orbit: the bar is a dial, and every step the kick plays casts a ray across the screen; traces ride their rings for four bars, and over sixteen bars the dial opens and closes. Weave: each bar is a row and the rows climb the screen, so the last bars stay in view and every change leaves a seam.

sections.title: Saved settings
sections.text: Patterns, tempo, swing, mutes, tune, decay, style and colors save automatically. Reopening keeps them and starts stopped.
